# verygood chocolate Sydney

Official Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/verygood_syd/
Made-to-order cakes and treats with chocolatier-grade couverture chocolate. Pickup in Melrose Park, Sydney. Sydney time: Wednesday & Friday 09:00–16:00 · Saturday & Sunday 09:00–12:00. No general pickup on Monday, Tuesday or Thursday. Requests are confirmed by our team after availability and payment checks.
Cookie and mochi pre-orders from 19 October 2026, subject to manual opening, with at least 24 hours preparation.
